# Darkvision

*[Rules Glossary](../index.md) > [Vision and Senses](index.md) | [D&D Beyond](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/rules-glossary#Darkvision)*

If you have Darkvision, you can see in [Dim Light](Dim-Light.md) within a specified range as if it were [Bright Light](Bright-Light.md) and in [Darkness](Darkness.md) within that range as if it were Dim Light. You discern colors in that Darkness only as shades of gray. *See also* "Playing the Game" ("[Exploration](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/playing-the-game#SpecialSenses)").
